name: Azure Storage static website hosting
line: Serve static website files from Azure Blob Storage.

free.text: $200 trial credit for 30 days; ongoing first 100GB egress free

cells.regions: Azure storage regions; Front Door is global

work.math: The cost depends on where files are delivered and on Blob reads, writes, lists and upstream data. Example: 1 million reads, 2,000 writes, 20 lists and 1 GB of upstream data = $44.63203715 a month.
Blob website mode serves static files and does not run API code.
Blob website mode does not provide API execution or PostgreSQL.
